description: Follow what loads what, from where the game starts (main scene, autoloads, every res:// path in project.godot, export include filters, the shipped file list from godotwright.json, add-ons, tests, editor scripts), through ext_resource, preload, load, class_name, folders and file names the code builds paths from, textures next to models and import settings. op `unused`: files nothing reaches, biggest first, whole folders as one line (when in doubt a file counts as used, so the list can be trusted). op `why` (file): the chain from the game to the file, before you delete or move it. op `of` (file): what a scene or resource loads with it, biggest first, what it can load later, and paths that do not exist. op `cycles`: scenes or resources that load each other through ext_resource, which Godot cannot load (it reports "[ext_resource] referenced non-existent resource" for a file that is there). Read-only.

file.description: why and of: the res:// file

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

name: godot_deps
title: The project's files as a graph: unused, why used, what a scene loads
